inputs.52.text: Modern high-end Japanese anime game cinematic key visual, sharp digital illustration with crisp thin lineart, realistic adult proportions, dramatic cel shading with hard-edged shadows, strong rim light, glowing bloom light effects, deep saturated color and high contrast. The Mississippi River at sunset in the 19th century: a vast shining river, a white paddle steamer with two tall smokestacks on the water in the left half, low river bluffs along the far bank on the right, crimson and gold sky, wide panoramic establishing view of the place standing empty and still.
